card.name: Rounding doses to nearest step
card.fires_on: Words that set a dose step or rounding target, such as "closest", "next higher", "nearest" and "mg" in "2.5 mg increments". Also fires on "cross" in words like criss-cross or crossed.

modes.label: Dose rounding and increments
modes.description: Words that say to round to the closest or nearest dose, or give the step size between doses.
modes.example: Decrease dose by approximately 25% to the<< closest>> dose achievable with the prefilled syring

modes.label: Crossing shapes
modes.description: The word cross inside criss-cross or crossed, describing a crossing pattern or posture.
modes.example: showing a criss<<-cross>> pattern of long, cigar-like shapes.
